page.overview:
Who is Bun?

Bun was born to his parents at Pebble Pond Village around 87/88 AG. His immediate family belonged to the middle class, but was not wealthy. Once he became old enough to do so, he helped to deliver skunk squids, though proved to be quite clumsy. He often dropped the squids during his deliveries, much to the other villagers' annoyance due to their extreme odor.

As he grew older, he heard heroic tales about soldiers past and present, including the Kyoshi Warriors. Based on these idealized tales and the fact that his older friends enlisted in the Earth Kingdom military, Bun developed the desire to become a soldier. Despite still being a young teenager, he eventually volunteered for the local army unit of General Andal, much to his parents' dismay. At the time, Bun was the youngest inhabitant of Pebble Pond Village to ever enlist in the military.

After just one week of training, Bun was assigned to fight in the next combat operation. While his parents were horrified, the young boy was eager to fight the Fire Army. He hoped to capture a Fire Nation dagger to gift it to his father and mother.

On the day before his first frontline deployment, Bun chanced upon a group of strangers who were confronted by several Pebble Pond Village inhabitants. The young boy attempted to make his way through the crowd with skunk sharks, but tipped and accidentally threw several of them onto other locals. The villagers fled in terror, but the strangers' leader Suki helped Bun up. Having overheard some of the previous conversation, he excitedly asked whether they were really Kyoshi Warriors. Mira and Aika affirmed this, adding that they were seeking to join the Earth Kingdom Army. Bun offered to help them, taking them to General Andal's ad hoc headquarters at his uncle's house. On the way, he commented that Andal would surely "flip" upon seeing them.
